// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.02

|gr1= Event Handlers

|gr2= Sounds

|descr= Sets given music track event handler. Will overwrite other music event handlers.
{{Feature|obsolete|Use [[addMusicEventHandler]] instead as it can stack music event handlers.}}

|s1= [[setMusicEventHandler]] [type, function]

|p1= type: [[String]] - "MusicStart" or "MusicStop"

|p2= function: [[String]] - script to be executed. Passes params array 0: class name of the sound in [[Description.ext#Music|CfgMusic]], 1: event handler id

|r1= [[Number]] - id of the event handler

|x1= <sqf>_ehID = setMusicEventHandler ["MusicStart", "hint str _this"];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_ehID = setMusicEventHandler ["MusicStop", "hint str _this"];</sqf>

|seealso= [[addMusicEventHandler]] [[removeMusicEventHandler]] [[playMusic]] [[removeAllMusicEventHandlers]]
}}
